blocks.text: DAGUPAN CITY – Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon said he intends to replicate the solution devised by the St. John Cathedral in this Pangasinan city to drain floodwater into a cistern under its parking lot to keep the church and its courtyard dry on rainy days. Dizon and Pangasinan Fourth District Representative Gina de Venecia visited Lingayen-Dagupan Archbishop Socrates Villegas on Thursday (September 17) to discuss an initiative to redirect floods down multiple “water detention basins” to be constructed beneath different parts of the city, similar to what the church now utilizes.
